# DevExpress.Win.VerticalGrid NuGet Package

Contains classes related to the [DevExpress WinForms Vertical Grid](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/vertical_grid/), a control designed to display a Property Grid-style UI or multiple dataset rows in a 90-degree inverted grid layout.

## Key Features

* Support for all major data source types.

* User layout customization options: row drag-and-drop operations, row customization (show, hide, reorder, and resize), column and cell selection, configurable grid titles and record headers, pinned rows, and layout save and restore options.

* High-speed data sorting and filtering: multi-column sorting, instant search, Query Builder, Filter Criteria Editor, Excel-inspired filtering, Filter Panel, most recently used (MRU) filters, and a comprehensive custom filtering API.

* Side-by-side record comparison.

* Data editing, input validation, and value formatting: multi-editor rows, error indication, masks, conditional formatting.

* WYSIWYG printing and export to Excel, Word, and PDF.

* Property Grid mode: Visual Studio or Microsoft Office view, property categories and collections, property descriptions, property menu, and property search.
